user.title: Add a TV
user.description: On the TV, open the TV Panel app. Its page shows the TV's address and a pairing code.

data_description.host: As the TV shows it, for example 192.168.1.50:8766

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description: Enter the six-digit code on the TV's TV Panel page. Keep that page open until pairing finishes.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the TV. Check that the TV Panel app is open on it and that the address is right.
error.invalid_code: That code is wrong. Check the code on the TV; after five wrong codes it shows a new one.
error.cannot_reach_ha: The TV can't reach Home Assistant at its local address. Set the local network URL under Settings > System > Network.
error.token_refused: The TV reached Home Assistant, but its new token was refused.
error.no_url: Home Assistant has no local URL to give the TV. Set one under Settings > System > Network.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
